name: Quietly
subtitle: Keep your friends. Leave the endless feed.
description: Free, MIT-licensed early releases of Quietly for SideStore and AltStore Classic.

apps.name: Quietly
apps.subtitle: Instagram, one intentional visit at a time.
apps.localizedDescription: Browse people you follow, Stories, messages and your own profile. Open shared videos individually, with the endless Reels and Explore feeds blocked. Free and open source. Early beta: layout changes can affect filtering. Message alerts work while open, not in the background. Requires Instagram sign-in and seven-day signing refreshes with a free Apple account.

versions.localizedDescription: Own-profile and followed-profile videos remain accessible. Selected Reels open one at a time; the endless Reels feed stays blocked. Early testing release; Instagram layouts can change.
